The campaign is live and servable. I'll check on it through the run, as you asked. First check-in is tomorrow midday Central.

Per-post results so far: the three posts cost about $2.52 to $2.76 per link click, which is too close to call on a small sample. I'll keep all three running and revisit at the next check.

Through June 11 the campaign has spent $373.84 on 129 link clicks, and the three posts are within a few cents of each other on cost per click, so I'm leaving them all running. The campaign ends at midnight Central on June 14. I'll wait until it's over and pull final numbers.

content.text: The full-run stats window is longer than the API allows (7 days plus 1 hour), so I'll split it into two pulls.

The Larkspur Shade campaign ran June 7 through June 14 (Central) and spent $686.02 of the $700 budget.

**Final recap**
- **Spend:** $686.02 (about $13.98 of the budget went unspent)
- **Impressions:** 617,793
- **Link clicks:** 235 (average about $2.92 per click)

Your sign-up count isn't visible to me, so check your own tracking for signatures.

**What I set up**
- **Campaign:** "Larkspur Shade Project - Petition June 2027", billed to the Amex ending 2637.
- **Line item:** one ad group, optimized for link clicks, with a $700 total budget and an $87.50 daily budget. It was scheduled to end at midnight Central on June 14. Its status still shows ACTIVE, but it stopped serving on schedule. I did not pause it.
- **Targeting:** United States, age 18+ (X's `AGE_OVER_18` option). I didn't use interests or keywords, since X's political-campaigning rules limit which targeting types are allowed. I also left audience expansion on the non-expanded setting.
- **Posts:** all three approved posts, all accepted by X's review. I didn't write any new copy.

**Choices I made that you should know about**
- **Link-click goal, not sign-ups:** without X's pixel, X can't see petition sign-ups, so I optimized for clicks to larkspurshade.org/sign.
- **One ad group:** I didn't split the budget across several, so the three posts rotated inside the same ad group. I checked results on June 8 and June 11. The posts had similar costs per click, so I didn't pause or shift any of them.
- **Launched without a pre-check:** you asked me to launch directly, so I did.

I didn't pull per-post totals for the full run, only through June 11. I can do that if you want to know which post performed best.
